comparisons.reason: Both are any-comment binary features over OC_comments, but the construct differs in breadth. Left requires a specific, verifiable procedural example, meaning an actual procedure, process, rule or practice, and excludes hypotheticals. Right accepts any specific, concrete illustrative example, including scenarios, instances and hypothetical or non-real-world ones. Right is therefore much broader. A concrete non-procedural case, or a hypothetical scenario, would score 1 on the right and 0 on the left.
